prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1029; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following side impact collision at intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle that failed to yield at the controlled intersection. Police report requested. Claimant reported wrist fracture and was transported by EMS to the emergency department.

Entry 2: Claimant's attorney has notified this office of representation and requested that all further contact be routed through counsel. Letter of representation placed in file. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel for signature.

Entry 3: Received initial medical records from the emergency department. Diagnosis confirms distal radius fracture of the claimant's left wrist, treated with closed reduction and splinting. Follow-up orthopedic consult scheduled. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the injury severity.

Entry 4: Liability review in progress. Scene diagram and witness statement obtained. Available evidence indicates the at-fault driver entered the intersection against a red signal. Third-party carrier contacted to confirm coverage limits and open a parallel claim for the at-fault party.

Entry 5: Counsel submitted a demand package including medical bills, wage loss documentation, and a treatment summary. Demand is under review. Requested clarification from counsel on outstanding physical therapy records before evaluation can be completed. File remains open pending receipt.
